subtitle: Special Subject - Design Project(AI Application for beginners)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will learn how to utilize various AI methods practically by utilizing the knowledge of AI learned in the preceding courses. The course will cover AI for text and image generation, as well as AI-based image recognition methods.
In particular, by learning practical applications, students will acquire the basic skills to utilize AI in finding problems and proposing ideas to solve problems in project design activities.
advice:
Based on the basic knowledge of AI already acquired in this course, students will acquire the means to actually utilize AI.
Although the preceding course, Project Design I, also proposes solutions, this course proposes ideas using AI as a final assignment for generative AI, image recognition, and image judgment, so that AI can be an option as a means of actually materializing these ideas rather than just being "ideas on a desk.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience learned and acquired in Project Design I and AI Fundamentals.

lessons.content:
■Guidance and Generative AI
Provide basic guidance on AI technology and enga
ge in research using generative AI.

■Generative AI and programs
Students will create programs using generative A
I and create a simple embedded system.

■Creative an Application
Develop a simple web application by building a p
rogram that uses generative AI.

■Image Recognition and Image Judgment
Confirm basic knowledge of image recognition and
 image judgment, and generate an actual judgment
 program.

■Image Recognition and Programs
Incorporate the generated image recognition prog
ram into other programs.

■Final assignment
Based on the theme that will be the final assign
ment, students will create a work that incorpora
tes image judgment.

■Reflection and self-evaluation
Review and self-evaluation of this course.

              授業科目の学習・教育目標

              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.Generative AI
2.Image Recognition

              In this course, students will learn how to utilize various AI methods practically by utilizing the knowledge of AI learned in the preceding courses. The course will cover AI for text and image generation, as well as AI-based image recognition methods.
In particular, by learning practical applications, students will acquire the basic skills to utilize AI in finding problems and proposing ideas to solve problems in project design activities.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Based on the basic knowledge of AI already acquired in this course, students will acquire the means to actually utilize AI.
Although the preceding course, Project Design I, also proposes solutions, this course proposes ideas using AI as a final assignment for generative AI, image recognition, and image judgment, so that AI can be an option as a means of actually materializing these ideas rather than just being "ideas on a desk.
